profile.headline: Android Developer at Fanatics
profile.summary:
Highly skilled Android software engineer with a strong background in Viewgroup(XML) and Jetpack Compose.
Demonstrated expertise in delivering projects while exploring new technologies and adhering to industry standards. Proficient in Kotlin for Android development with a history of working in Java for Apache Spark and Spring Boot applications. Accumulated 7 years of professional experience with 4 years of Android development experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Android
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Android Platform Engineer
positions.description: As an Android Engineer II, I develop scalable, testable code for mid-sized features like networking and view components independently while making architectural or design choices and improvements whenever opportunities arise. I am trusted to speak directly to clients to communicate blockers and promote changes that are in the best long term interest of their application.
positions.insights: Android Development, Jetpack Compose and +12 skills

positions.description: At Infosys, I was responsible for contributing to a variety of problems for clients. In that process, I primarily developed Apache Spark applications and worked within Spring Boot applications.
